operator_observation: The app crashes immediately on launch; do not repeat this trial.
cause: ARMv7 iOS objc_msgSend may clobber r9; the Keychain importer incorrectly kept its save-asset table base in r9 across Objective-C calls, causing subsequent low-address UTF-8 string pointers. Local ARMv7 emulation reproduced the invalid pointer when r9 is clobbered.
rollback: In-place upgrade to previously observed noncrashing ios/BirzzleFever-HB-offline-startup.ipa completed without uninstalling the app. No second physical launch was performed.
corrected_successor: ios/BirzzleFever-HB-offline-state-fixed.ipa is built and emulator-tested with the table base in preserved r11; it has not been installed or manually tested.
privacy: Original raw reports stay ignored and private; no token, UID, member identifier or report filename is published.
